p.seg: he is the one who is deemed capable insofar as he is capable of employing people;
and as for the commoner he is deemed capable insofar as he is capable of doing things himself.
If officials and dignitaries, within to their separaate duties follow their instructions,
the feudal lord rulers, in accordance with their different territories, take care of their obligations
and the Three Dukes , comprehensively debate overall issues regarding all regions,
then the Son of Heaven, hands down, will put things right."
The reason why they do not get to go beyond what is within their care
is that they are averse to any selfish kind of generosity."
The Son of Heaven takes good care of everyone in the world,
and the feudal lords take good care of what is within the boundaries of their feoffs.
（公元398年—公元445年）author of 後漢書
what (all!) they go on about is "benevolence" and "righteousness" (the words!)
and what they propagate is the models of the Sages.
張溫（193年—230年），字惠恕，吳郡吳縣（今江蘇蘇州）人。少修節操，容貌奇偉。孫權召拜議郎、選曹尚書，徙太子太傅。 皇甫嵩（？—195年），中国东汉末年镇压黄巾起义的重要将领。
and if they had been looking up and down and just looking around (without taking resolute action)
then the great enterprise (of the empire) would have taken a different turn.
